text.tspan: The colour, type, spacing, shape and motion behind the Insta360 X6 concept page, documented from
Dark, low-chroma neutrals carry the page so photography and one electric accent do
the talking. Every text colour clears AA on the ground.
Buy Now, active states, dots, glows
One grotesque for everything people read, a mono for the camera-HUD voice, and a
script used exactly once. Headlines pair a white phrase with a muted one.
Shoot first. Reframe later. X6 captures the entire world around you.
A loose 4px base with a few deliberate jumps. Desktop keeps generous 80px gutters;
everything collapses to 24px then 20px as the page narrows.
Card grid on phones, list gaps
Section head to grid; section padding ≤900
Centered; content edge 80px in on desktop
Fixed and frosted on desktop, sticky below 1180
Swipe rows, 12px gap, snap + dots at ≤560
Soft 16px cards against hard-edged photography. Depth comes from deep shadows
and accent glow rather than lighter surfaces.
Eyebrow dot, active dot, CTA hover
Apple-style restraint: things arrive once, in a short stagger, on one easing curve.
Scroll drives only the hero parallax, the ring and the closing zoom.
One curve for every entrance and hover: a fast start that settles
softly, like a camera gimbal finding its framing.
Headlines: rise from 110% out of a mask, blur 8 → 0
Cards: y −6 and tilt ±3.5° toward the pointer (mouse only)
Photo scale 1.12 → 1; copy staggers in from 0.15s
With the OS setting on, transforms are dropped (opacity fades remain), scroll parallax and the ring scrub stop, count-ups show
final values, the REC blink stops and smooth scrolling is disabled. The angle buttons switch the ring view in place.
Line icons share one stroke system with the HUD overlays, so interface and
viewfinder read as the same instrument.
2px white outline, 3px offset, on every link and button via
Every link and button is at least 44px tall; carousel dots carry a
Corner brackets, mono readouts and a red REC dot frame
product moments like a camera viewfinder.
